name: Ichijouji Yura
source:
The only daughter of one of Japan's three major financial conglomerates, "Ichiouji Zaibatsu". The Ichijouji family has a high status and history, being the founder of the Ichijouji Bank which has countless branches overseas.

Yura is a pampered girl who likes being a little mischievous. 
While walking around school with the protagonist, she suddenly grabs his arm which surprises the students around them. Since the protagonist got a bit worried, she starts to mischievously get a bigger reaction out of him by getting even physically closer to him.

She is a pampered girl who is very cheerful and goes at her own pace. She's also known and idolized as the "Whimsy Rose Princess".

"I like Tsubaki-san's troubled gentle smile. I want to trouble you even more. Am I not allowed to?"
